identity_lock.silhouette: User-approved K06 v3 seated Little Chihiro with fixed navy beret, ash-beige bob, navy dress, satchel and rabbit.
identity_lock.proportions: The approved F08/F10/F12/F14/F16 drawings control head, torso, skirt, legs, shoes and accessory scale.
identity_lock.placement: Normalize complete drawings to K06 visible height, head center x=256, visible baseline y=472 and pivot (256,492); independently verify shoe midpoint stability.
identity_lock.motion: Only the image-right free forearm/hand, gaze, eyelids and tiny touched-rabbit-ear response progress through the pat cycle.
identity_lock.costume: Collar, orange bow, brass buttons, lace hem, strap, satchel, rabbit, socks and shoes remain complete and topologically fixed.
identity_lock.rendering: Fine dark outlines, low-luminance ash-beige hair, restrained warm cel shading, fixed front camera and uniform lighting.

threshold_notes.min_adjacent_diff: The ten-frame loop contains deliberate half-step hand motion and a slow blink; individual direct transitions are expected to be subtler than the approved sparse references.
threshold_notes.center_lock: Outer silhouette changes with the free forearm. qa/stabilization-report.json enforces head center, shoe midpoint, visible height and baseline instead.

fingertips near the ear without contact

generation.method: Each missing frame is a separate complete-character built-in imagegen call using both bounding approved frames and the canonical model reference.
generation.forbidden: No interpolation, optical flow, local translation, part compositing, deformation, morphing or cross-fade.
